gloss: to meet face-to-face; to confront; to come face-to-face with

definitions.gloss: to meet face-to-face; to meet in person
definitions.explanation: To meet someone directly, in person rather than remotely. Often implies a significant or awaited meeting.

definitions.gloss: to confront; to come face-to-face with
definitions.explanation: To face something directly, including difficult situations, challenges, or uncomfortable realities.

examples.japanese: {久|ひさ}しぶりに{対面|たいめん}した。
examples.english: We met face-to-face for the first time in a while.

examples.japanese: オンラインではなく{対面|たいめん}で{話|はな}したい。
examples.english: I want to talk in person, not online.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{赤|あか}ちゃんと{対面|たいめん}した{瞬間|しゅんかん}、{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The moment I met the baby for the first time, tears came to my eyes.

examples.japanese: {現実|げんじつ}に{対面|たいめん}する。
{困難|こんなん}に{対面|たいめん}しても{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: I won't give up even when confronted with difficulties.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{避|さ}けてきた{問題|もんだい}に{対面|たいめん}する{時|とき}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: The time has come to confront the problem I've been avoiding for years.

notes:
Has become especially common since the COVID-19 pandemic, where {対面|たいめん} (in-person) is contrasted with オンライン (online) or リモート (remote) in work and education contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対面|たいめん}{授業|じゅぎょう}: in-person classes
- {対面|たいめん}{販売|はんばい}: face-to-face sales
- {対面|たいめん}で{会|あ}う: to meet in person
- {対面|たいめん}{式|しき}: face-to-face format

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {面会|めんかい}する: to visit/meet — used for visiting someone in hospital, prison, etc.
- {直接|ちょくせつ}{会|あ}う: to meet directly — more casual alternative
- {対峙|たいじ}する: to confront/stand against — stronger, implies opposition or standoff
